title: Atom simplification (CRP-BE-03): coarse area atoms do not widen access beyond PRD matrix
preconds: Build with CRP-BE-03 atom simplification deployed. Atom-diff CLI available.
steps:
1. Run atom-diff CLI in pre-simplification mode (or against a snapshot captured before BE-03).
2. Run atom-diff CLI in post-simplification mode.
3. For each system role and a few representative custom roles, diff atom sets.
4. Spot-check 5 endpoints whose guarding atom was collapsed: does each role with access pre-collapse still have access? Does each role without access pre-collapse still lack access?
expected: No role gains access to any endpoint it didn't have before. No role loses access to any endpoint it should have. Atom simplification is permission-preserving.
